notes: GPUI VIEWS plus a large store. The target UI framework is GPUI 0.2.2 (Zed's framework), not React, and you have no training knowledge of its exact API. Before writing, read: the finished panel crates as worked examples (rever-ui-traffic, rever-ui-menus, rever-ui-history: their src and examples/preview.rs show how views, listeners, hover, scrolling, text fields, theme, strings and previews are done here), every file in rever-ui-kit/src, and vendor/gpui/src/elements/*.rs plus vendor/gpui/examples/*.rs (animation.rs for the overlay's motion) for exact method names. stores/scan.ts (826 lines, with a test file) drives Red Team scans: port it first as a plain struct with methods and port every test case; its IPC calls (`window.rev.*`) and its calls into other stores go behind traits or closures the host supplies later; timers take the current time as an argument. Already ported logic to use as path dependencies instead of re-porting: rever-chat-core (red_team_mode, redteam_categories), rever-ui-state (scan_mode, tabs), rever-scope (findings dedupe and scope). Then the views implementing gpui::Render: ScanPopup (target, intensity, categories, progress, findings list, export, stop) and AiActionOverlay (the overlay that shows what the agent is doing on the page: cursor, click ripple, highlight boxes, labels; it is drawn over the page area, so expose it as an element the host paints on top of the page with page-relative coordinates). Colors and sizes come from src/renderer/src/styles.css (tokens in rever_ui_kit::theme::Theme; define a missing one locally and list it). User-facing strings go through `rever_ui_kit::i18n::Lang::t(key)` with the keys the TSX uses. Keep logic in plain functions with Korean-named unit tests; a file gets the `Port of` marker only when its behaviors are all there. Preview: fill examples/preview.rs so `cargo run -p rever-ui-scan --example preview_scan` shows the popup mid-scan with findings and the overlay over a placeholder page; capture with `scripts/capture-window.sh preview_scan /tmp/preview_scan.png`, read the PNG, compare with the TSX, fix what is off. Do not bring windows to the front, do not capture the screen any other way, do not run the `rever` app, and never run cargo without `-p` (other crates in the workspace are mid-edit).
